Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (His earlier voice mail) Hey, it's me. So I was trying to tell you before, but we kept breaking up. Sorry, I missed you at the airport. I got caught up with my band, but I can't wait for you to hear the song we recorded. I wrote it just for you. Call me when you can. I miss you.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, it's an old mini safe of mine that I found in the back of my closet. I've had it for ages, but I haven't used it in so long that I forgot the combination. I thought your brothers could open it. I figured that's a "safe" bet. Heh heh!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. Umm, so listen. I'm really sorry, but something's come up and I won't be able to make it to our date tonight. I hope you understand. (Candace doesn't respond) Hello? ...Candace, are you there? ...Hello?...Helloo? Well, I guess we got cut off.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Really? She told me the same thing about you. Anyway, I'm over at the Sci-Fi Fantasy convention with little Suzy. She's really into the kids stuff. You know, like Sea-Horsie Hospital, or you know, lame stuff like Ducky Momo. (Seeing a person in a Ducky Momo costume) Ooh.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, he's part of a team that makes and manages reconnaissance satellites. They actually had a couple of rovers on Mars earlier this summer. But they suddenly stopped working. You wouldn't know anything about that, would you?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: And finally, after a very exotic day, our monotreme takes a moment to not do much. Grabbing a well-earned cuddle with everyone's favorite hard-working assistant/producer/girlfriend. Oh! Gotta charge my phone!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You know, it's a little unusual...here we are sitting in the very heart of a giant soccer stadium your brothers built in your yard...and you haven't once shown any desire to bust them.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, wait a second! I call you Candace, but not because I don't care enough to come up with a cute nickname for you! I call you Candace 'cause... I happen to really like that name.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Nah. I came to see this hot new band called PFT. I downloaded their song this morning. It's tight! The hundredth contestant gets to sing onstage with the band!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wait. You're Gary Frank! You were the most popular senior two years in a row! Dude. You gotta join us for a pizza break. It'll be fun to catch up and talk.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow! You guys are the best! This was truly an amazing day! It's too bad Candace missed the whole thing. And, Ferb, where did you learn to serve like that?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Then you shouldn't let your brothers' fun ruin your good time. You know, if you get a chance to sing, you oughta sing. I gotta go, I'll see you later. (Walks away)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, I guess he's really gone, Suzy. You got to admit, he was a lot of trouble. But deep down, I'm gonna miss that big guy. Come on, let's go inside.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Eh...both. She said something about going to find the "other Candace" and-and Mom and then she went all wild when I mentioned stopping by tonight.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, no. Their platypus doesn't do much. (Perry jumps out of the building and takes a plunger and sticks it onto the bottom of the "nose" of the building.) Well, let's take another shot at learning this solo. (Doof plays the riff better.) Hey, doc, not bad. I think you might be getting it!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (Laughs) What do you know? Some sort of reptile hopping around. Hi little hopping reptile. Hi little jumping chameleon. Hi little springing salamander.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: It's a day in the life of an exotic animal, and Perry's the most exotic animal I know. So it's you and me documenting Perry all afternoon.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: We can't let a little rain put a damper on our-- wow! (Sees the biosphere, and Candace panics) I guess your brothers have been busy, huh? Oh, we should have our picnic in there!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: What are you two doing here? I mean, not that I don't like surprise visits from you, but this room is for Slushy Dawg employees only.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Have you seen the fancy dancing on the show? I can fake it in the school auditorium. Just not on a nationally syndicated dance show.

Name: Jeremy-2
Dialog: We should really get out of here while we can. (he hands her a pair of sunglasses) Most of the Normbots are away in the other dimension. We can slip away pretty easily.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: My mom told me to bring over these homegrown veggies for your family. You know; she and your mom are doing that jazz thing today.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (comes over with a gift box) Hey, Candace! I had a break, and I, uh, I thought I'd give you this for your birthday. (Gives her the box, she opens it) I saw you looking at it in the gift shop.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, since I have no idea what will happen next, I need to tell you something. (He kneels down and holds onto Candace's hand.) I love you, Candace Flynn. Will you marry me?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (enters) Wow! A party in the lake? I never would have thought of that! You come up with the best ideas! We can go to the mall tomorrow.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Let me guess, you had your brothers build me something super cool for my birthday and now it disappeared. It's okay, I get it.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah, the Tooth Fairy never visited me when I was a kid. (pause) Anyway...could you give this to your brothers? I gotta rush to work.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: It was this crazy contraption doing all those dance moves. If you wanna see what a real dancer looks like, then here you go!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, I love having some kid's feet in my face as much as the next guy. But how about we just go grab a Slushy Burger?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yes, I am totally messing with you. Now, would you please knock off the phony British stuff and go back to being my girl?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, in a minute Candace. I'm right in the middle here. I was thinking maybe you could help me finish decorating. First.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I remember you loved them in that magazine. And you were even gonna have your good necklace made into a pair like them.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. My mom played me some of their CD. Your singing is awesome! How'd you get your voice to sound like that?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: But...but... I was just gonna ask him to clean the bathroom. (walks up to a female employee) Um, Dolores, this is the part of the job I hate the most.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, Candace, you made it. I was thinking you weren't gonna show. Although, you know, usually we get on at the bottom.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Thomas got me two touchdowns, twenty-three points last week, and 189 yards. I'm in first place in my keeper league.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. I just finished my side of the house and I'm heading home. It was nice hanging out with you all day.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Listen, I got called into work and my parents aren't home, do you think you could look after Suzy for a few hours?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah, took her a week to get through it. You didn't think she really did all those things? Candace? Do you mind? (He takes out a pen as to sign her cast)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, hey, Candace, I see you've sent me some pictures. I can't wait to check 'em out later when I take my break.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. It's really nice of you to make something for me. I can't wait to see what you've come up with.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah, it's new. I'm so bored. Feels like by the time my shift is over, I'll be a part of the fossil exhibit.

Name: Jeremy-2
Dialog: I didn't know they were your brothers, but I should've known. They're smart and courageous, just like you.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: An Anglophile such as myself? (he realizes what she is referring to) Oh, ha! I get it. Well...yes. I could listen to you speak like that all day.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, man. Your sister's entered us in some big dance show. And, you know, I just don't wanna let her down.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I didn't know you did water sports, 'cause I'm going to the Extreme Water Park today. Why don't you come?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You know, your brothers are all right. Hey, are you okay? (Candace points to the ground) Oh, afraid of heights. Don't worry, I got ya.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: That? That's not your present. That's my drain unclogger. I don't know why I carry that around with me.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah, it was weird... You and I were in this Dixieland band and there was an iguana playing an oboe...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, I remember that! In grade school, a pretty girl loaned me that pencil and I've kept it ever since.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I just got the new Destruction Mayhem 3 game. I thought maybe you'd like to come over and try it out.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, I can't do this. All those great dance moves I've been doing today? Well, it was actually...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace, look! I did it. I wrote a letter to Santa saying in great detail what gift I want most.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, I'd really like to help you with your latest busting endeavor, but I have customers waiting. (points to the band singing in line)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah. My room was covered in flyers, so I came over. I like LARPing. I get it if you think it's lame.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Ta-da! Your brothers have opened the trendiest restaurant in town, and this is where I'm taking you.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I'm havin' a hard time gettin' there. (Cut to outside the car to reveal a huge traffic jam.) Looks like this whole town is going to this cool new car wash.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Here, come on. Let's see what we can do about that. I've got a glass of water with your name on it.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace? I really don't mind waiting a bit. It's actually kinda fun just hanging out here with you.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I saw ya on TV and just wanted to congratulate you. I guess you're, like, on a whole new level now.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You ready for your bath, huh, boy? Who loves Candace? Oh, who's a beautiful boy? Who loves Candace?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. I'm taking my mom's car to this crazy new car wash. Would you like to go for a ride?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, yeah, I used the...ugh, hold on! (He runs to the opposite side of the bridge) Yeah, I used the G-word. It doesn't freak you out, does it?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. I don't know what all that was about before, but I wanted to give you your present.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: No, not weird, it's just-- (a customer walks up) Oh, wait, I got a customer, Candace. I'll - I'll call you later, okay?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You know, my dad goes on and on about the cafeteria here, and I think he's right. This food is...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I'm really glad you wanted to come over, Candace. Most girls really aren't into stuff like this.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I'm just glad you're not one of those people who freaks out just because someone cancels a date.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Way! I'm excited to see what you two come up with! But you better get started, time's a-tickin'!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah. I stopped by your house to give you your present and Irving just told me to jack right in.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. The things they make us wear, huh? At least you don't have a weenie on your head!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I didn't wanna break our date. I just wanted to earn some extra money, so I could surprise you.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You know, Candace, I was trying to say back there that...well, the thing I like about you is...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, the day's not a total loss. We had a great time at the water park. Wanna go back tomorrow?

Name: Candace/Jeremy
Dialog: (In unison) This is Candace/Candace, it's Jeremy. Jeremy? Candace? (Both laugh) Okay, you go. Okay, you talk, you talk. (Both laugh)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I bet that's the first time anybody's ever said that. By the way, (hands Phineas a folded piece of paper) Ferb left this clue for you.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Maybe Ducky Momo isn't really that lame after all. Someone else seems to really like him too.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Listen, I gotta get back to work, but if you like, I can swing by your house after I'm done.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (greeting people as he passes them) Yo, T-Bone! Hey, Clammo! What up, Sassy Miss K? Momo! Binkie... (reaches Stacy and Candace) Hi Candace, where you been?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. I just wanted to thank you for sending over the pizzas. That was really cool.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I need you and Perry for a summer school project for college credit. It's a zoology course.

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: Come on! I'm a tree! We're friends with squirrels! ... Oh, snap. (to Nerdcrow (Baljeet)) Oh, that's got to hurt.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, my folks asked me to keep an eye on Suzy for the afternoon. Who's my favorite girl?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace, I heard you were having a dessert party, so I made you this out of gelatin. (He reveals Candace's name, made from gelatin)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You know, Candace, I've had a lot of fun in your backyard, but this is the best time yet.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: It is you! I was just over there in a taxi and I saw you over... What are you doing here?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I mean, it's like your hair was genetically engineered to ensnare those giant fruit bats.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, why don't you bring Perry to the park and we can wash him together? Sound like fun?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Um, something jumped on me and started swallowing me whole and it kinda looked like you!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: 'Scuse me, sir? Oh, Candace? Wow, in that outfit, I couldn't even tell you were a girl.

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: Hi! You've been selected for a free haunted castle makeover from Witches Brew magazine.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Check it out. This umbrella makes a sweet raft. You wanna float down the river with me?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (walks into room) Hey, sis. I can't find my lucky baseball bat. I've looked everywhere. Have you seen it?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Allow me. (He reaches up top for something, while Candace pushes a basket away) Here you go, one nose hair clipper. Do you want me to put it in your basket?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, guys. I, uh, just wanted to see if you'd come with me. (Shows his ribbon) To the big aglet concert.

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: Yeah, we're kind of expected in Bustopolis. You know; the Wizard, great and powerful.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Okay, so, I was wondering if you wanted to do something tonight? Just the two of us?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I know! It's awesome, right? It's our motto: Slushy Dawgs will never get any better.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I was saying you can really tell a lot about a person by the way they treat animals.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (Wearing a jetpack and has a volleyball in his hand) Hey, Candace! Jetpack Volleyball? This is a great idea! You're gonna join us, right?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, that is so cool how you busted your brothers like that! Will you marry me? (Daydream ends)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, there's some street performers over there that– I'll go get another towel.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Suzy? No. She's at her friend's house. (The door knocks and he pauses the game) Uh, hold on, Candace. Someone's at the door. (Opens the door)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Are you kidding? It's amazing! You win, you win! I'm going to get your blue ribbon.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (looks at his watch) Well, that's the hour. I'm gonna pack up my gear. I got another lesson across town.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hold on, Candace, I'll save you! (He jumps off the cliff, using the giant umbrella as a parachute. He grabs her just as she is about to fall) I got you, Candace! (They float down to the bottom and out of the biosphere, onto the front lawn.) Oh, man, I love this umbrella!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I bet you guys have heard a lot of strange sentences over the course of the summer. (hands Phineas a Slushy Dawg)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (taking his costume off) I need to rethink my career trajectory. I'll call Candace and explain why I'm late.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You know what I'd like to do, Candace? I'd like to rent one of those little boats.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, you sure you're okay? (Candace gulps) Come on, my uncle's restaurant is right over here.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (At his house) You know, I'd love to, but my dad's taking me to check out his old college today.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Thanks. Most of my favorite bands are British. I guess I'm kind of an Anglophile.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: She sort of wandered off about 20 years ago. We don't really talk about it much.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: He's already set up an interview with an academic adviser. Can you believe that?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (On phone) Hi, Candace.  It's Jeremy. I was wondering if you wanted to go for a walk today?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (opening the gate) Hey, Candace. I was just stopping by to invite you... (awkward pause) Hmm. Well, nice mom suit.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I didn't know you were helping out my mom. You made quite an impression on her.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Ah, that's my girl. Looks like it's just you and me, little gallivanting gecko.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Of course. I'm so glad you finally decided to change everything about yourself.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: She said she was going to "help" the boys. Does that sound like Candace to you?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Okay, well, maybe we should get goin'. Hop in, everyone! We're goin' cruisin'!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Don't worry, Candace. Just stick with me and I'll get you through this, okay?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, man, I gotta get home and help my mom. I'll be back in a couple of hours.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Are you sure, Candace, 'cause it looks like you may wanna bust your brothers.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Don't you think we should sit together to watch the show? If-if you want to.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (to Coltrane) What do you think it means when a girl leaves a fake mustache at your house?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: But I'm sorry about all this, Candace. I-I just didn't want to let you down.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I just called to let you know I'll be at the big pet wash at the park today.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah. Instead of cars, we wash pets for charity. You know, you can really...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I don't think he likes it! Do all platypi do that, or is that a Perry thing?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: So, circus, huh? Cool. Cool. I guess it's more of a cirque than a "circus". (laughs)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: So, our moms are gonna start playing when they unveil the statue. Wanna go?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: That might be why they made me assistant junior manager. Just got promoted.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Ooh, and apparently, monotremes chitter every ten seconds. (to Candace) Mark that down.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (offscreen) Candace? (walks up to her with headphones) While I check the stockroom, can you take the drive-thru orders?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wait, y-you can't leave now! You would...just get off on the next bridge!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Heh, no. The thing I really like about you is... (There is a sudden crash. Candace yelps. Apparently, Ferb has just flipped the switch to turn the desert into a rainforest, for trees shoot up out of the ground. A pipe shoots water out, beginning to create a river) Wow, this is incredible!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I know this is a weird question, but do you have any idea how I got here?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow, Candace, I had a really good time. You want to get something to eat?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, career plans? Uh, probably a couple years of community college and...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I guess it's set, then. We gotta do it for our grandmas. Right, Candace?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. Sorry I'm running late, but I just finished getting ready.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Actually, I'm kinda havin' fun. You know, crazy, prison-break kinda fun.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: No, actually Candace, you just paused it. (Game sounds) And now you've reset the game.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Okay, bye. I gotta get home. Suzy's pretty upset about Santa not coming.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Suzy. What are you doing out here, and what's with the lumpy table?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Cool. It's gonna be wicked. I'm going as a caveman. I'll see you there.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah, my Mom made it. I'll go get some plates out of the picnic basket.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I'm on my way to build houses for charity. You girls want to come with?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, Candace, I think you've got a little food or something on your lip.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, hungry little guy? Let's get some footage of Perry eating. (Pull out to reveal Candace not there.) Candace?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Why don't you stay here with Suzy, and I'll go buy you some ice cream?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, hey, Perry. Come up here. How's my favorite little platypus today?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, you should know me better than that. Look, I have to go home.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Actually, it's funny you called because you were in my dream just now.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: That's okay. I like you just the way you are. Happy New Year, Candace.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: A well-balanced diet is vital to the health of any semiaquatic mammal.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Suzy, you're acting kinda weird. You're not hiding anything, are you?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You're quite the S'Winter athlete. By the way, have you met Dee Dee?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, they're breaking for coffee. (Jazz music) Wanna come over? We can hang out.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah, that's Suzy's dog. (Rubs her head) Who's a good girl? Who's a good girl? Yeah.

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: Well, yeah, but I'll bet you don't have anything in your bag for me.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: And being together like this makes me realize what I like about you.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Ah, I'm just here on the Mr. Slushy Burger worker exchange program.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Everybody calm down! We're safe, look! (Picks the "Lake Nose Monster" up) It—It's just some driftwood.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hi, Candace. What do you say to a little picnic? You know, indoors.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, that pretty girl was you. See, those are your teeth marks.

Name: Jeremy's voice
Dialog: Documenting Perry's life all afternoon... afternoon... afternoon...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. You ran away so quickly, we didn't get a chance to--

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (Holding the frame Romantic Candace had bought) Your mom said you got this picture frame for me at the mall today.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh yeah. Yeah, funny I didn't think of that one. (Notices that Candace is running away.) Candace? Candace?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Duh. Remember the whole "your girlfriend ordered the pizza" thing?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Great. Just need some assistance with this equipment from the car. (exits)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Don't worry, Candace. To be honest, not much happens around here.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: As I was saying, being a lifeguard takes focus and concentration.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: It's certainly interesting, but...it's not what I like about you.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Jeremy Johnson. My Mom's hosting a book club today, who is this?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, those first two. Not that last one. She's cool. She's sweet.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Thanks for coming, Candace. Suzy's been waiting for you all day.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Sure, yeah they were just here. They went home to look for you.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh. Yeah. (screen flips to Jeremy showing her around the picnic) Why don't I introduce you around? You know my folks.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: But it's so hot out here, and you made me work a double shift!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace! Have you no mercy?! Come on, Grandma. Let's go home.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I gotta meet my Mom in the food court, but I'll see ya later?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (in non-belief) Uh...huh. Well, it's a statement. You guys have fun now. Bye!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I was just about to comment on them. They're really up there.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (on phone) Candace... what I think... I though...we should...break...up.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Mrs. Flynn-Fletcher, you wanna see the footage of Perry?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Huh. That's funny. I never knew cavemen wore safety helmets.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow! Candace, you've  got to teach me how to skate like that. (He takes Candace's hand, and Suzy hits the button again, and both Candace and Jeremy are sent flying back)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (Laughs) What are you talking about? Little Suzy wouldn't hurt a fly.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah. Only, uh, uh, Candace, is that what you're gonna wear?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Okay, uh last, but not least, we have the Flynn-Fletchers...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (Picks up his phone) Hey Stacy, how's it going? No, I haven't heard from Candace.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (while Perry quickly reverts to pet mode) I think he's behind that tree. (picks Perry up, who chatters again; hands him to Candace) See, he's glad you found him.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, I love that you came to visit, but rules are rules.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: That's okay, Candace. You looked like you were pretty busy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I would hope my girlfriend would have a little trust in me.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: The only thing is it needs a picture. Anybody got a camera?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Okay, but hurry. The games are the best part of the picnic.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You'd be surprised how strong my arms are. Don't hold back.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (offscreen) What do you need? What do you need? You know what you need?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: But isn't that why you changed? So I would like you better?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, hang on, Coltrane, there's a fly in here. Lemme get it.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, look out the window of the salon in ten seconds, ma'am!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Sure, Candace! Um.. I'm gonna go get some fresh air, okay?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Um...heh. What's so special about this freaky guitar solo?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, this sure beats all that rain. Not too hot, are you?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, hey, Candace! Did you come to pick up your MP3 player?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (to Candace) I don't know about you, but I'm gonna have another cookie. (eats another cookie)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow, you look beautiful...I guess you all look beautiful.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. You know I don't play drums. I play guitar.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey...cute redhead...talking funny. See ya after the set.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah, it's a total surprise. I'm taking her to the rodeo.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah, this is the part of the job I hate the most, but...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Huh? Oh, what was that? And why did it look like Candace?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I'm gonna go grab some snacks. I'll meet you over there.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Cool. I always liked your brothers. I'm coming with you.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hi, Candace. I was wondering if you could do me a favor?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (walking up with Coltrane, holding a tray with four glasses of sparkling cider on it) Candace? Stacy told me about your New Year's resolution.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah. Grilled cheese, 'cause I know it's your favorite.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. This fossil is my favorite in the museum.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, Candace? Why is my grandma yelling at your grandma?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Sure, no problem. What's in this platypus food, anyway?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: No, you look great! Hop in! (Candace opens the side door and gets in.) What'd you do to your hair?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Ah, it's not so bad. I mean, we're together, aren't we?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: It was awesome. So, we still on for the movies tonight?

Name: Jeremy Dragon
